title: AI Weekly: Key Developments and Breakthroughs
intro: This week saw notable advancements in AI research, major industry moves, and new product launches from leading companies. Here are the most significant updates you need to know.

items.heading: OpenAI's Astra Model Tackles Math Problems
items.body: OpenAI announced its latest model, Astra, which reportedly has solved or made significant progress on 10 longstanding mathematics and computing problems. This development could have implications for both theoretical research and practical applications, highlighting continued rapid progress in AI capabilities.

items.heading: Nvidia to Acquire Run:ai for $700 Million
items.body: Nvidia is set to acquire Run:ai, a Tel Aviv-based company specializing in AI workload management, for $700 million. This move signals Nvidia's intent to strengthen its position in AI infrastructure and resource optimization, supporting the growing demand for efficient AI development.

items.heading: Adobe Unveils AI Video Upscaling Project
items.body: Adobe has introduced an AI upscaling project capable of transforming blurry videos into high-definition quality. This technology could benefit content creators and media professionals by streamlining video enhancement workflows and improving the quality of archival or low-resolution footage.

items.heading: Tencent Begins Testing Handy Bot Personal Agent
items.body: Tencent has entered the personal AI agent market with an internal test of a product code-named Handy Bot on WeChat. This signals growing competition in the personal assistant space and the increasing integration of AI agents into popular social platforms.
